title: 第一卷 第23章 狼牙山第一卷 第24章 狼魁要逃
lines: 第二天一早，秦烈醒了之后，还是看了一下自己的面板。
看到八品初期这几个字的时候，心里安稳了不少。
手里的自由属性点虽然只剩下了不到五点，但境界提升到了八品，肯定比昨天的实力要强得多。
况且今天又不是他一个人去，还有陆沉和李虎他们跟着，应该没有太大的危险。
最大的变数还是红色状态的许青禾，那实力真是没的说。
不过能小心一点，还是要小心一点的好。
秦烈可不想自己刚进镇妖司没几天，就成了别人嘴里的倒霉蛋。
洗了把脸之后，又穿上了镇妖司的黑色劲装。
昨天那套已经被狼妖抓得破破烂烂，穿不了了。
还好镇妖司一开始给他发了两套衣服，不然今天就得花钱买了。
也不知道回头去镇妖司能不能再免费领两套。
“秦烈，起床了，我们要出发了！”
刚收拾好，门口就传来了李虎的声音。
秦烈推门出去，发现大家都已经在院子里站着了。
陆沉穿着一身黑色劲装，腰间挂着长刀，神色还和平常一样。
李虎则是靠在院门口，怀里抱着刀，嘴里还叼着一根不知道哪儿拔来的狗尾巴草。
看起来跟那些武侠画本里的洒脱不羁的高人还真有几分像。
许青禾还是一如往常地抱着自己那本小册子，站在旁边。
秦烈看了她一眼，很快又把目光收回来了，不然他怕许青禾又把剑架在他脖子上。
“你的伤怎么样了，要是没好的话，就在家里歇着也行。”
“就那些个小杂鱼，你李虎大爷我去就能够搞定了。”
李虎看到秦烈出来，问了一嘴。
“已经好得差不多了，不影响行动。”
听秦烈这么说，李虎忍不住看了他一眼。
“你小子这身子骨是铁打的吗？昨天刚被五只狼妖围着挠了一顿，今天就好得差不多了？”
秦烈笑了笑。
“可能是因为我身体素质比较好，所以恢复得比较快。”
李虎刚想再说点什么，旁边的陆沉开口了。
“你现在已经八品了吗？”
“八品！”
秦烈还没回答，李虎倒是吃惊起来了。
“是的，这两天修炼了一下基础炼体法，所以练着练着就突破了。”
秦烈没有隐瞒的打算，如实回答。
前天还是不入流，今天八品了，气血值的变化肯定非常大。
这种事情肯定瞒不过陆沉这种老手。
content_en:
Early the next morning, after Qin Lie woke up, he still looked at his panel.
When I saw the words "eighth grade early stage", I felt a lot more at ease.
Although there are only less than five free attribute points left in his hand, his realm has been upgraded to the eighth level, which is definitely much stronger than yesterday.
Besides, he wasn't going alone today. There were Lu Chen and Li Hu following him, so there shouldn't be much danger.
The biggest variable is Xu Qinghe who is in the red state. His strength is really indescribable.
But it’s better to be careful if you can.
Qin Lie didn't want to become the unlucky guy in other people's mouths just a few days after joining the Demon Suppression Division.
After washing his face, he put on the black uniform of the Demon Suppression Division.
Yesterday's suit had been scratched by the wolf demon and was in tatters, and could no longer be worn.
Fortunately, the Demon Suppression Department gave him two sets of clothes at the beginning, otherwise he would have to spend money to buy them today.
I don’t know if I can get two more sets for free by going back to the Demon Suppression Division.
"Qin Lie, get up, we're leaving!"
As soon as they finished packing, Li Hu's voice came from the door.
Qin Lie opened the door and went out and found that everyone was already standing in the yard.
Lu Chen was wearing a black outfit, with a long knife hanging on his waist, and his expression was the same as usual.
Li Hu was leaning against the door of the courtyard, holding a knife in his arms and holding a piece of dogtail grass pulled out from somewhere in his mouth.
He looks a bit like the free and uninhibited masters in martial arts books.
Xu Qinghe still stood beside him holding his booklet as usual.
Qin Lie glanced at her and quickly looked away, otherwise he was afraid that Xu Qinghe would place the sword on his neck again.
"How is your injury? If it's not healed, you can just rest at home."
"Just those little miscellaneous fish, you, Uncle Li Hu, and I can take care of them."
Li Hu saw Qin Lie coming out and asked.
"It's almost better now. It won't affect our actions."
Hearing what Qin Lie said, Li Hu couldn't help but glance at him.
"Are your bones made of iron? You were surrounded by five wolf demons yesterday and were scratched. Are you almost feeling better today?"
Qin Lie smiled.
"Maybe it's because I have better physical fitness, so I recover faster."
Just when Li Hu was about to say something more, Lu Chen next to him spoke.
"Are you already at level eight now?"
"Eighth grade!"
Before Qin Lie could answer, Li Hu was surprised.
"Yes, I have been practicing basic body training methods in the past two days, so I have made a breakthrough as I practice."
Qin Lie had no intention of hiding anything and answered truthfully.
The day before yesterday, I was still not in the flow. Today, I am in the eighth level. The change in Qi and blood value must be very big.
This kind of thing definitely cannot be hidden from an experienced person like Lu Chen.
